title: From the guitar to the alto saxophone in 1929
summary: Fooling with his father's guitar led him to buy an alto sax at C. G. Conn's store on Baronne at age 17.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the first horn: clarinet and saxophone beginnings

blocks.x: Can you tell us, we may go back to your father and the older musicians later, but I wondered about how did you get started and how did you, which instrument did you start on and all that?

Well, I'll tell you, I always did like the guitar. But the people wasn't like the other day. Well, the old man played the guitar and he would put it in the corner and we'd go fool with the guitar, but we didn't know how he knew we would fool with the guitar. But sometimes we'd fool it and get it out of tune, but he would know that somebody would fool him with the guitar. But it took us time to kind of catch on to the trick, you know. If we fooled with it, he had it in tune and he would know that somebody had been fooling with the guitar. But we would always pick it up, pick it up anyhow, you know. If we was going to get a beat, we'd pick it up anyhow. But we wanted to know how he could tell that we'd been fooling with the guitar. But we didn't have sense enough to know that we'd move one of them buttons and get it out of tune that he was going to know that he left it tuned up. So that was the trick until I began to learn how to tune it up. So when I began to learn how to tune it up, well he couldn't tell. So on the other hand, well after that I liked the guitar and then the enticement to get the saxophone.
How old were you when you started doing the guitar?
Well, I was a kid from the guitar, but I started outright in 1929 when I was 17 years old. So I started from C.G. Coyne and it was on Barone between Canal and Common.
Did you have a music school with it too?
C.G. Coyne had their own store, yeah, on Barone store. So I got a saxophone from there and then later on, well I come back and… What kind was it?
Alto. Alto sax. How old was that when you got the saxophone? 29. 29.
And then I… Where did you go?
